print.description: Prints a value to the standard output.

bool.description: A boolean type representing true or false.

void.description: A type indicating that a function does not return a value.

var.description: Declares a variable with its type inferred from the initializer.

int.description: Declares a variable or parameter of type int, a 32-bit signed integer.

float.description: Declares a variable or parameter of type float, a single-precision floating-point number.

double.description: Declares a variable or parameter of type double, a double-precision floating-point number.

char.description: Declares a variable or parameter containing a single character.

string.description: Declares a variable or parameter containing a sequence of characters.

bool.description: Declares a boolean variable or parameter that can hold true or false.

void.description: Specifies that a function does not return a value.

if.description: Begins a conditional statement. Its block executes when the condition evaluates to true.

else.description: Defines the block executed when the preceding if and all option conditions evaluate to false.

option.description: Defines an additional conditional branch of an if statement. Options are evaluated in order after the initial if condition fails.

while.description: Begins a loop that repeatedly executes its block while the condition evaluates to true.

for.description: Begins a for loop for repeated execution based on an iteration condition.

return.description: Terminates the current function and optionally returns a value to its caller.

continue.description: Skips the remainder of the current loop iteration and continues with the next iteration.

function.description: Declares a function with a name, parameters, return type, and body.

struct.description: Declares a structure type that groups related data fields into a single type.
